prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a low-speed head-on collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1291; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presents front-end damage consistent with the reported low-speed head-on impact, including a cracked bumper cover, displaced grille, and a damaged hood leading edge with bent radiator support brackets. Damage pattern and location line up with the account given at intake, and no prior damage to this vehicle is known from the records reviewed. The proposed repair plan replaces the bumper cover, grille, and hood, straightens the support brackets, and refinishes the affected panels. Labor hours are in line with the work described. The invoices reviewed show no duplicated or repeated charges, and the estimate is recommended for approval as submitted.
